In-house (not outstaff) ‼️

We are looking for a Business Development Lead (Software Services) 📈

🎯 Requirements:
• 3–6 years of experience selling software outsourcing, nearshore teams, or custom software development services
• Proven track record of meeting sales targets and closing complex deals
• Strong network in the UK, EU, and/or US markets
• Experience with full-cycle sales: prospecting, discovery, proposals, negotiations, and closing
• Strong consultative selling and commercial negotiation skills
• Experience shaping deals with engineering/delivery teams (T&M, dedicated teams, fixed-scope)
• Understanding of GTM strategy, ICP, positioning, and pricing
• Experience with CRM, sales forecasting, and pipeline management
• Ability to build and lead a BD, marketing, and pre-sales team as the business grows
• Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus
